A '''museum''' on [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]] had a priceless work of [[Khommite/Legends|Khommite]] art on loan that was stolen from it. The museum wanted to discreetly recover the piece before word of the theft got out. The stolen statue was retrieved, and it was revealed that a museum employee helped a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] collector illegally acquire the piece.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Stolen Statue}}</ref>
